jp: 情報がまだ記載されていないカード。特殊な魔術が施されており、ぶつけた相手の情報を記録する。個人情報を勝手に持ち出すも同然であり、身内意外に使うと怒られるのは必至。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～

en: An unregistered card with special magic. It records information from the person hit by it. Using it on anyone other than close friends will definitely make them angry, as it's like stealing personal information. \n#~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "An unregistered card with special magic. It records information from the person hit by it. Using it on anyone other than close friends will definitely make them angry, as it's like stealing personal information. \n#~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una carta su cui non è ancora scritta nessuna informazione. Ha addosso una magia particolare, e registra i dati di chi colpisce. È come portarsi via i dati di una persona senza permesso: usarla su chi non è di casa fa arrabbiare di sicuro. \n#~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: イチゴ味のソフトクリームではない。あまりにも芸術的な形に仕上がったフン。まごうことなき芸術なので当然爆発する。その威力は宝石細工と生化学の技術に依存するという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～
jp_grezzo: "イチゴ味のソフトクリームではない。あまりにも芸術的な形に仕上がったフン。まごうことなき芸術なので当然爆発する。その威力は宝石細工と生化学の技術に依存するという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～"
en: This is not mere strawberry ice cream. But a masterpiece of shit, sculpted with such artistic perfection. And like any true art, it naturally explodes, the magnum poopus. Its explosive power depends on the techniques of gem-cutting and gene-engineering.\n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "This is not mere strawberry ice cream. But a masterpiece of shit, sculpted with such artistic perfection. And like any true art, it naturally explodes, the magnum poopus. Its explosive power depends on the techniques of gem-cutting and gene-engineering.\n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Non è un gelato alla fragola. È uno sterco venuto in una forma fin troppo artistica. Essendo arte a tutti gli effetti, va da sé che esplode. La sua potenza, dicono, dipende dalle tecniche di Oreficeria e di Ingegneria genetica.\n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: 缶の中で発酵し続けた保存食の成れの果て。解読によると古代の魚の塩漬けだったらしい。パンパンに膨らんでおり、強い衝撃を与えると臭気が噴出し生化学と料理の技術に依存した爆発を起こす。開封は危険なので内部を物質感知したところ、中身が分解されてほとんどガス状になっていることが判明した。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～
jp_grezzo: "缶の中で発酵し続けた保存食の成れの果て。解読によると古代の魚の塩漬けだったらしい。パンパンに膨らんでおり、強い衝撃を与えると臭気が噴出し生化学と料理の技術に依存した爆発を起こす。開封は危険なので内部を物質感知したところ、中身が分解されてほとんどガス状になっていることが判明した。\n#～移り変わりゆくティリスの食～"
en: The result of a preserved food that has been fermenting in a can. According to analysis, it appears to be an ancient salted fish. The can is extremely bloated, and if subjected to strong impact, it will release a powerful stench, causing an explosion dependent on user's gene engineering and cooking skills. It is dangerous to open, as scans reveal the contents have mostly degraded into a gaseous state.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~
en_grezzo: "The result of a preserved food that has been fermenting in a can. According to analysis, it appears to be an ancient salted fish. The can is extremely bloated, and if subjected to strong impact, it will release a powerful stench, causing an explosion dependent on user's gene engineering and cooking skills. It is dangerous to open, as scans reveal the contents have mostly degraded into a gaseous state.\n#~Everchanging Food of Tyris~"
it: Quel che resta di una conserva che nella scatola ha continuato a fermentare. A leggerla pare fosse pesce salato dei tempi antichi. È gonfia da scoppiare, e a darle un colpo forte sprigiona il fetore e fa un'esplosione che dipende dalle tecniche di Ingegneria genetica e di Cucina. Aprirla è pericoloso, e sondandone dentro la materia si è scoperto che il contenuto si è decomposto ed è quasi tutto allo stato di gas.\n#~Il Cibo Mutevole di Tyris~

jp: 魔術士が製造したあまりにもでかい雪の結晶。水にやさしい言葉をかけて凍らせると美しい結晶になる、という怪しい学説を検証したらしい。人間に美醜を決められてたまるか、人間の言葉で話しかけてくるな、そもそも勝手に凍らせるな、といった不満によって瞑想と宝石細工の技術に依存した爆発を起こし敵を傷つける。\n#～魔具全典～
jp_grezzo: "魔術士が製造したあまりにもでかい雪の結晶。水にやさしい言葉をかけて凍らせると美しい結晶になる、という怪しい学説を検証したらしい。人間に美醜を決められてたまるか、人間の言葉で話しかけてくるな、そもそも勝手に凍らせるな、といった不満によって瞑想と宝石細工の技術に依存した爆発を起こし敵を傷つける。\n#～魔具全典～"
en: Too-big-to-be-true snowflakes manufactured by wizards. Apparently, they tested a dubious theory that if you speak kind words to water and freeze it, it will turn into beautiful crystals. The wizard's hypothesis- that humans should not be allowed to decide what is beautiful or ugly, that he should not speak in human terms, and that humans should not freeze these without permission in the first place - which cause explosions that rely on user's meditation and gem cutting skills. \n#~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Too-big-to-be-true snowflakes manufactured by wizards. Apparently, they tested a dubious theory that if you speak kind words to water and freeze it, it will turn into beautiful crystals. The wizard's hypothesis- that humans should not be allowed to decide what is beautiful or ugly, that he should not speak in human terms, and that humans should not freeze these without permission in the first place - which cause explosions that rely on user's meditation and gem cutting skills. \n#~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un cristallo di neve fin troppo grosso, fabbricato da un mago. Pare che verificasse una teoria sospetta: che l'acqua, se le si parla con dolcezza e poi la si congela, diventi un bel cristallo. Il suo malumore (non sia mai che siano gli uomini a decidere che cosa è bello; e non mi si parli con parole d'uomo; e soprattutto non mi si congeli senza permesso) fa un'esplosione che dipende dalle tecniche di Meditazione e di Oreficeria, e ferisce i nemici. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: 周囲を暗黒で包む不殺兵器。その威力は戦術と射撃の技術に依存するという。文献によると、かつてこの世界には閃光弾というものが溢れていた。しかし突如現れた暗黒弾に敗れ、閃光弾は歴史の闇へと葬り去られたのだとか。\n#～続・明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～
jp_grezzo: "周囲を暗黒で包む不殺兵器。その威力は戦術と射撃の技術に依存するという。文献によると、かつてこの世界には閃光弾というものが溢れていた。しかし突如現れた暗黒弾に敗れ、閃光弾は歴史の闇へと葬り去られたのだとか。\n#～続・明日から使えるあなたの為の武具集～"
en: Non-lethal weapons that envelops its surroundings in darkness. Its power is said to depend on user's tactics and marksmanship skills. According to documents, the world used to be full of flashbangs. However, they were defeated by the sudden appearance of darkbangs, and the flashbangs were buried in the darkness of history. \n#~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow Cont.~
en_grezzo: "Non-lethal weapons that envelops its surroundings in darkness. Its power is said to depend on user's tactics and marksmanship skills. According to documents, the world used to be full of flashbangs. However, they were defeated by the sudden appearance of darkbangs, and the flashbangs were buried in the darkness of history. \n#~Collection of Armaments you can Use Tomorrow Cont.~"
it: Un'arma non letale che avvolge di buio tutto intorno. La sua potenza, dicono, dipende dalle tecniche di Tattica e di Mira. Secondo i documenti, un tempo questo mondo era pieno di colpi accecanti; poi comparve di colpo il colpo oscuro, li batté, e i colpi accecanti furono sepolti nel buio della storia. \n#~Ancora Armi e Armature da Usare Domani~

jp: 避雷針から発展した装置。魔力防護によって針自体に落雷のエネルギーを貯めこみ、必要に応じて放電できるようになっている。放電の出力は魔力制御と魔力の限界に依存するらしい。窃盗や破損を恐れて普段は仕舞われているが、雷雨になると魔術士たちが野外に設置し始める。\n#～魔具全典～
jp_grezzo: "避雷針から発展した装置。魔力防護によって針自体に落雷のエネルギーを貯めこみ、必要に応じて放電できるようになっている。放電の出力は魔力制御と魔力の限界に依存するらしい。窃盗や破損を恐れて普段は仕舞われているが、雷雨になると魔術士たちが野外に設置し始める。\n#～魔具全典～"
en: Device based on the lightning conductor. The needle itself stores the energy of lightning strikes through magical protection and can discharge it as needed. The output of the discharge is said to depend on the user's Control Magic and Magic Capacity skills. Normally, they are stored away for fear of theft or damage, but when a thunderstorm occurs, mages begin to set them up in the open air. \n#~Arcane Almanac~
en_grezzo: "Device based on the lightning conductor. The needle itself stores the energy of lightning strikes through magical protection and can discharge it as needed. The output of the discharge is said to depend on the user's Control Magic and Magic Capacity skills. Normally, they are stored away for fear of theft or damage, but when a thunderstorm occurs, mages begin to set them up in the open air. \n#~Arcane Almanac~"
it: Un apparecchio nato dal parafulmine. Con una protezione magica l'ago stesso accumula l'energia dei fulmini, e la scarica quando serve. La forza della scarica, pare, dipende da Controllo magia e da Capacità magica. Di solito lo tengono al chiuso per paura dei ladri e dei danni, ma quando viene il temporale i maghi cominciano a piantarlo all'aperto. \n#~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: 通称、疫の箱。プレゼントに偽装してあるが、狐が相手を化かし殺す際に使う化学兵装。寄生虫を利用して作られており、相手の脳に作用して意識障害をもたらす。その脳波を妖術で周囲の敵に伝播させて二次被害をもたらす。その威力は罠の知識と生化学の技術に依存するという。\n#～もう化かされない！魔物の罠の見抜き方～
jp_grezzo: "通称、疫の箱。プレゼントに偽装してあるが、狐が相手を化かし殺す際に使う化学兵装。寄生虫を利用して作られており、相手の脳に作用して意識障害をもたらす。その脳波を妖術で周囲の敵に伝播させて二次被害をもたらす。その威力は罠の知識と生化学の技術に依存するという。\n#～もう化かされない！魔物の罠の見抜き方～"
en: Also known as box of plagues. Disguised as a gift, it is a chemical armament used by foxes as deterrants. It is made from cultivated parasites, which acts on the opponent's brain and causes disorientation. The brain waves are then transmitted by sorcery to surrounding enemies, causing secondary damage. Its power is said to depend on the skills of Disarm Traps and Gene Engineering of the user. \n#~Fool me twice, Shame on me!~

Its power is said to depend on the skills of Disarm Traps and Gene Engineering of the user. \n#~Fool me twice, Shame on me!~"
it: Detta anche la scatola della pestilenza. È mascherata da regalo, ma è un'arma chimica che le volpi usano per stregare e uccidere. La fanno coi parassiti: agisce sul cervello e porta disturbi di coscienza. Poi la stregoneria propaga quelle onde ai nemici intorno e fa danni di rimbalzo. La sua potenza, dicono, dipende dalle tecniche di Disarmo trappole e di Ingegneria genetica. \n#~Non ci Casco Più! Come Scoprire i Trucchi dei Mostri~

jp: しつけのなっていないペットが増えて社会問題になっていたため、その解決策として導入された。ペットに持たせると、券と引き換えに訓練を受けることができる。各家庭に無料配布されており、ペットを飼っていない人は飼っている人にプレゼントして酒をおごってもらうなどの使い方をしているようだ。\n#～パルミア広報～
jp_grezzo: "しつけのなっていないペットが増えて社会問題になっていたため、その解決策として導入された。ペットに持たせると、券と引き換えに訓練を受けることができる。各家庭に無料配布されており、ペットを飼っていない人は飼っている人にプレゼントして酒をおごってもらうなどの使い方をしているようだ。\n#～パルミア広報～"
en: Introduced as a solution to the increasing number of untrained pets, which was becoming a social problem. Pets can be trained in exchange for this coupon. They are distributed free of charge to each household, and people who do not have pets can use them as gifts for those who do. \n#~Palmia Public Services~
en_grezzo: "Introduced as a solution to the increasing number of untrained pets, which was becoming a social problem. Pets can be trained in exchange for this coupon. They are distributed free of charge to each household, and people who do not have pets can use them as gifts for those who do. \n#~Palmia Public Services~"
it: È stato introdotto come rimedio a un problema sociale: i compagni maleducati erano sempre di più. Dandolo a un compagno, in cambio del biglietto viene addestrato. Lo distribuiscono gratis a ogni famiglia, e chi un compagno non ce l'ha pare lo regali a chi ce l'ha, per farsi offrire da bere. \n#~Bollettino di Palmia~

jp: 「訓練券で受けられるのは基本コースまでです。それ以上は所持金払いじゃないと割に合わないので」\n#～ペットトレイナーの言葉～
jp_grezzo: "「訓練券で受けられるのは基本コースまでです。それ以上は所持金払いじゃないと割に合わないので」\n#～ペットトレイナーの言葉～"
en: The training ticket will only take them up to the basic course. Anything beyond that is not covered.\n# ~words of a Pet Trainer~
en_grezzo: "The training ticket will only take them up to the basic course. Anything beyond that is not covered.\n# ~words of a Pet Trainer~"
it: \"Col biglietto si arriva al corso base e non oltre. Più in là non conviene, se non si paga in contanti.\"\n# ~Parole dell'Addestratore di Bestie~

jp: 「訓練券も使えますが手続きが面倒なので所持金払い歓迎！」\n#～訓練所の張り紙～
jp_grezzo: "「訓練券も使えますが手続きが面倒なので所持金払い歓迎！」\n#～訓練所の張り紙～"
en: Saving tickets is annoying! Pay in Cash!\n# ~words at the Training Center ~
en_grezzo: "Saving tickets is annoying! Pay in Cash!\n# ~words at the Training Center ~"
it: \"Il biglietto si può usare, ma la pratica è una noia: meglio pagare in contanti!\"\n# ~Avviso Affisso alla Palestra~

jp: 現代で一般的に使われているポーションの栓。普通の人にとってはゴミである。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～
jp_grezzo: "現代で一般的に使われているポーションの栓。普通の人にとってはゴミである。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～"
en: A potion plug commonly used in modern times. To the average person, they are garbage. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "A potion plug commonly used in modern times. To the average person, they are garbage. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
it: Il tappo di pozione che si usa comunemente oggi. Per la gente normale è spazzatura. \n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: 自慢できるほどに立派な鎖。首でも手首でも足首でも、場所を選ばず付けられるデザインが人気だが、首に付けてネクタイっぽく垂らすのが一番スタンダードだ。\n#～選ぼう、大切な人への贈り物～
jp_grezzo: "自慢できるほどに立派な鎖。首でも手首でも足首でも、場所を選ばず付けられるデザインが人気だが、首に付けてネクタイっぽく垂らすのが一番スタンダードだ。\n#～選ぼう、大切な人への贈り物～"
en: A magnificent chain to be proud of. The design is popular because it can be worn anywhere, on the neck, wrist, or ankle, but the most standard is to wear it around the neck and drape it like a necktie.\n#~Gift for your loved ones~
en_grezzo: "A magnificent chain to be proud of. The design is popular because it can be worn anywhere, on the neck, wrist, or ankle, but the most standard is to wear it around the neck and drape it like a necktie.\n#~Gift for your loved ones~"
it: Una catena tanto bella da vantarsene. Piace perché il disegno la lascia mettere dove si vuole, al collo, al polso, alla caviglia; ma il modo più comune è portarla al collo e lasciarla pendere come una cravatta.\n#~Scegliamo un Dono per Chi ci sta a Cuore~

jp: 「他の奴隷が最近やたらと立派な鎖を見せびらかして自慢してくるのだ。俺もたまらなく立派な鎖が欲しい！」\n#～鎖自慢された奴隷の言葉～
jp_grezzo: "「他の奴隷が最近やたらと立派な鎖を見せびらかして自慢してくるのだ。俺もたまらなく立派な鎖が欲しい！」\n#～鎖自慢された奴隷の言葉～"
en: \"Don't hate me chains because they beautiful, maybe get yourself some cool ass golden chains you'd be braggin 'bout them like me.\" \n# a Slave showing off his chains.
en_grezzo: "\"Don't hate me chains because they beautiful, maybe get yourself some cool ass golden chains you'd be braggin 'bout them like me.\" \n# a Slave showing off his chains."
it: \"Gli altri schiavi, da un po', mi sventolano davanti le loro belle catene e se ne vantano di continuo. La voglio anch'io una catena bella così!\" \n#~Parole di uno Schiavo Fiero delle Sue Catene~

jp: でっかいサメのぬいぐるみ。なかなかジョーズに作られており、とってもフカフカ。しかしイルヴァのサメはぬいぐるみに制作者が名前をつけるのが主流。そのため、ぬいぐるみに自分で名前をつけたい派の人類からは敬遠されているし、ぬいぐるみに名前をつけない派の人類からは幼稚とされ、あまり需要がない。\n#～サメ信者大全～

en: Large stuffed shark. It is quite jawsome and very fluffy. However, sharks in Ylva are usually named by their creators on their plush toys. For this reason, they are shunned by humans who want to name their plush toys themselves, and are considered childish by humans who do not name their plush toys, and are not in great demand.\n#~Shark Believer Compendium~
en_grezzo: "Large stuffed shark. It is quite jawsome and very fluffy. However, sharks in Ylva are usually named by their creators on their plush toys. For this reason, they are shunned by humans who want to name their plush toys themselves, and are considered childish by humans who do not name their plush toys, and are not in great demand.\n#~Shark Believer Compendium~"
it: Un pupazzo di squalo bello grosso. È fatto proprio a pinna d'arte, e morbidissimo. Solo che a Irva, per i pupazzi di squalo, di regola è chi li fa a dare loro un nome. Per questo chi il nome vuole darlo da sé lo evita, e chi ai pupazzi il nome non lo dà lo trova infantile: di richiesta ce n'è poca.\n#~Grande Compendio dei Fedeli dello Squalo~

jp: 野外には生育していない花。ネフィアに自生しておりネフィアの魔力を根から吸っているのだが、こういった形態の植物はデルネフィア以外ほぼ全てモンスター化している。デルネフィアだけモンスター化しないメカニズムについては長年にわたり研究されているが、難航しているとされる。安全な階層には生えにくいことに加え、薬効がありモンスターや冒険者に好んで食われてしまうことから、サンプル数が少ないのだ。\n#?ティリス園芸図鑑?

en: A flower that does not grow outdoors. It grows wild in Nefia and absorb its magic using the roots, but almost all plants in this form are monstrous except Dernefia. This very oddity has been studied for many years, but alas fruitless. In addition to the fact that it is difficult to grow in safe layers, it has great medicinal value, which is why there are so few samples of it.
en_grezzo: "A flower that does not grow outdoors. It grows wild in Nefia and absorb its magic using the roots, but almost all plants in this form are monstrous except Dernefia. This very oddity has been studied for many years, but alas fruitless. In addition to the fact that it is difficult to grow in safe layers, it has great medicinal value, which is why there are so few samples of it."
it: Un fiore che all'aperto non cresce. Nasce spontaneo nelle Nefia e ne succhia la forza magica dalle radici, ma le piante fatte così, tranne la dernefia, sono quasi tutte diventate mostri. Perché solo la dernefia non diventi un mostro lo studiano da anni, e pare che non ne vengano a capo. Ai piani sicuri attecchisce male, e in più ha virtù che curano, così che mostri e avventurieri se la mangiano volentieri: di campioni ce n'è pochi.

jp: 「ジュア様に似合う幻の花があるらしい…贈ればきっと口ではなんだかんだ言いながらも喜んでくれるんだろうな…ちょっとネフィア行ってくる」\n#?ジュアの狂信者の独り言?

it: È una pianta che, a mangiarla, cura un poco. \n#~Rapporto di Identificazione: categoria <Piante>~

jp: プラスチック製のフタ。軽くて丈夫でリサイクルも可能。ペットボトルと呼ばれる容器が活躍していた時代には共に世に溢れかえっていた。しかしながら洗わずにリサイクルに出す者が多く、リサイクルのコストや手間が増大し再資源化が破綻。道端に捨てていく馬鹿のせいで環境汚染が進行し、エコテロリストによる矛先を間違えたテロも勃発。ボトルキャップを高速射出する道具で社会を牛耳ろうとする悪党まで出現。百年以上に渡り積み重なった諸々の社会問題にメーカーが耐え切れず、製造中止に至ったとされる。安価で加工しやすい疑似ガラスが普及した現代では完全に過去の遺物と化している。\n#?私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ?

en: Plastic lid. Light, strong and recyclable. Abundant in the world when plastic bottles were still used. However, many of them were not washed and sent for recycling, and there are idiots who discard them and cause environmental pollution, and eco-terrorist attacks have also broken out because of it. A villain even attempts to control society with a weapon that ejects bottle caps at high speed. It is said that the manufacturers could not stand the various social problems accumulated, leading to the discontinuation of production. Today, with the spread of cheap, easy-to-process pseudo-glass, they have completely become a relic of the past.\n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~

it: Un coperchio di plastica. Leggero, resistente e riciclabile. Ai tempi in cui andavano le bottiglie di plastica ne era pieno il mondo. Solo che in tanti li buttavano nel riciclo senza lavarli, i costi e la fatica sono cresciuti e il recupero è saltato. Per colpa degli imbecilli che li gettavano per strada l'inquinamento è andato avanti, e sono scoppiati anche attentati di ecoterroristi che avevano sbagliato bersaglio. È perfino comparso un malvivente che voleva tenere in pugno la società con un arnese che sparava tappi ad alta velocità. Si dice che i fabbricanti non abbiano retto ai problemi accumulati per più di cent'anni e abbiano smesso di produrli. Oggi che si è diffuso il vetro finto, che costa poco e si lavora facile, sono del tutto roba del passato.\n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: 小さなガラス玉。近年では観賞用を兼ねて様々な模様・色のものが用いられている。名前の由来は不明だが、古代の言葉でガラスを意味するビードロが変化してビーダマという説、等級がＢの玉だったのでビーダマという説、Ｂ魂に反応する玉だからビーダマという説の３つが有力とされている。内部に模様が入っているタイプは模様をフレイムと呼称することがある。こちらについては、特に名前がなかったところにガセ用語が定着したという説、Ｂ魂に反応して燃える炎のように見えることがあるのでフレイムという説の２つが有力。\n#?私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ?

The origin of the name is unknown, there are theories that B-dama is a ball that reacts to the B soul. The pattern inside is sometimes called Flame, because it looks like the Burning Flame inside of a Burning Soul.\n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~

it: Una pallina di vetro. Da qualche anno se ne fanno anche con fantasie e colori vari, che servono da ornamento. Da dove venga il nome non si sa: le tre spiegazioni più accreditate sono che venga da biidoro, che in lingua antica vuol dire vetro; che fossero palline di grado B; e che siano palline che rispondono all'anima B. Quelle col disegno dentro hanno un disegno che a volte chiamano fiamma, e anche qui le spiegazioni più accreditate sono due: che a una cosa senza nome si sia attaccato un termine inventato, e che si chiami fiamma perché a volte, rispondendo all'anima B, pare una fiamma che brucia.\n#~Le Mille Cianfrusaglie che Amo~

jp: \t\t警告用のホイッスル。短く鋭く吹き鳴らすことで、聴いた者の気を引き締める。音量自体は大したことが無いので、寝ている者を起こすのには向いていない。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t警告用のホイッスル。短く鋭く吹き鳴らすことで、聴いた者の気を引き締める。音量自体は大したことが無いので、寝ている者を起こすのには向いていない。\n#～玲瓏たるイルヴァの調べ～\n"
en: Warning whistle. A short, sharp blast is used to alert anyone who hears it.The volume itself is not very loud, so it is not suitable for waking sleeping people.\n#~Tunes of Irva~
en_grezzo: "Warning whistle. A short, sharp blast is used to alert anyone who hears it.The volume itself is not very loud, so it is not suitable for waking sleeping people.\n#~Tunes of Irva~"
it: Un fischietto d'allarme. Soffiandoci un colpo corto e secco, chi lo sente si fa attento. Il volume in sé non è granché, quindi per svegliare chi dorme non va bene.\n#~Le Melodie della Limpida Irva~

jp: \t\t一生に一度もモテなかったセミ。土の中に何年も引きこもっていたが、このままではいけないと意を決して街コンに参加。慣れないなりに求愛に挑戦し続けたが、報われることなく力尽きてしまった。どうせ死ぬなら最期まで前のめりでありたい、と必死に足掻いている。\n#～イルヴァ昆虫大百科～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一生に一度もモテなかったセミ。土の中に何年も引きこもっていたが、このままではいけないと意を決して街コンに参加。慣れないなりに求愛に挑戦し続けたが、報われることなく力尽きてしまった。どうせ死ぬなら最期まで前のめりでありたい、と必死に足掻いている。\n#～イルヴァ昆虫大百科～\n"
en: Cicada had never been popular in its life. After years of being cooped up in the dirt, it decided that it could not go on like this and entered a town. It kept on trying to court females in a way it was not accustomed to. It desperately wants to stay in the forefront until the end of its life if its going to die anyway. \n#~Irva Insect Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Cicada had never been popular in its life. After years of being cooped up in the dirt, it decided that it could not go on like this and entered a town. It kept on trying to court females in a way it was not accustomed to. It desperately wants to stay in the forefront until the end of its life if its going to die anyway. \n#~Irva Insect Encyclopedia~"
it: Una cicala che in tutta la vita non è mai piaciuta a nessuno. Dopo anni chiusa sottoterra ha deciso che così non poteva andare ed è scesa in città a cercare compagnia. Ha continuato a corteggiare come poteva, ma senza mai un premio, e alla fine le forze le sono venute meno. Se morire deve, vuole morire buttandosi in avanti fino all'ultimo, e si dimena con tutta l'anima. \n#~Grande Enciclopedia degli Insetti di Irva~

jp: \t\tぶつけるとびっくりして生化学と投擲とレベル依存の轟音の波動を発生させる。衝撃に耐えられずに絶命することもある。\n#～イルヴァ昆虫大百科注釈～\n

en: When hit, they are startled and generate a wave of roars, depending on thrower's gene-engineering and throwing skills. Normal human may not be able to withstand the impact and will probably die. \n#~Irva Insect Encyclopedia (Footnote)~
en_grezzo: "When hit, they are startled and generate a wave of roars, depending on thrower's gene-engineering and throwing skills. Normal human may not be able to withstand the impact and will probably die. \n#~Irva Insect Encyclopedia (Footnote)~"

jp: \t\t「夕暮れの　暑さ残りし　道端に　のたうつ蝉の　声が消えゆく」\n#～無名吟遊詩人の短歌～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「夕暮れの　暑さ残りし　道端に　のたうつ蝉の　声が消えゆく」\n#～無名吟遊詩人の短歌～\n"
en: \"Evening heat lingers, and the sound of cicadas on the roadside fades away.\" \n#~Songs of a nameless poet~
en_grezzo: "\"Evening heat lingers, and the sound of cicadas on the roadside fades away.\" \n#~Songs of a nameless poet~"
it: \"Nel tramonto, sul ciglio dove il caldo ancora dura, si spegne la voce della cicala che si contorce.\" \n#~Le Liriche di un Bardo Senza Nome~

jp: \t\t様々な文章や絵が書かれている紙。大事に封筒に入れられているが、このままだと一般的に価値はない。\n#～本の為の本～\n

en: Paper with various texts and drawings on it. They are carefully placed in envelopes, but are generally of little value in this state. \n#~Big Book of Books~
en_grezzo: "Paper with various texts and drawings on it. They are carefully placed in envelopes, but are generally of little value in this state. \n#~Big Book of Books~"
it: Un foglio con sopra scritti e disegni di ogni sorta. Lo tengono con cura dentro una busta, ma così com'è, in genere, non vale niente. \n#~Il Libro dei Libri~

jp: \t\t冷気を吸収する魔力を持つ曲がった石。冷気を放つ際にレンズのようにして魔力を通すと凍結破壊を抑えられる。しかしその効果範囲は非常に狭く、周囲を覆う冷気から身を守るためには役に立たない。\n#～不思議な古代装飾品～\n

it: Una pietra ricurva con la forza magica di assorbire il gelo. Quando si manda gelo, facendoci passare la magia come attraverso una lente, si trattiene la rottura da congelamento. Ma il raggio in cui agisce è strettissimo, e per ripararsi dal gelo che copre tutt'intorno non serve. \n#~Misteriosi Ornamenti Antichi~

jp: \t\t複数ブロックに火薬が詰められたタル。ぶつけると爆炎を発生させて周囲を焼き払う。それとは別に、火がつくと火炎の残滓を噴き出す。いずれも威力は工作と生化学の技術に依存する。\n#～危険物取扱マニュアル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複数ブロックに火薬が詰められたタル。ぶつけると爆炎を発生させて周囲を焼き払う。それとは別に、火がつくと火炎の残滓を噴き出す。いずれも威力は工作と生化学の技術に依存する。\n#～危険物取扱マニュアル～\n"
en: A barrel with multiple blocks of gunpowder packed in it. When hit, it produces an explosive flame that burns away the surrounding area. Apart from that, when set on fire, it spews out a residue of flame. The power depends on one's carpentry and engineering techniques.\n# ~Hazardous Materials Handling Manual~

Apart from that, when set on fire, it spews out a residue of flame. The power depends on one's carpentry and engineering techniques.\n# ~Hazardous Materials Handling Manual~"
it: Un barile con dentro più blocchi di polvere da sparo. A colpirlo genera una fiammata che brucia tutt'intorno. E per conto suo, se prende fuoco, sputa fuori quel che resta della fiamma. In tutt'e due i casi la potenza dipende dalle tecniche di Falegnameria e di Ingegneria genetica.\n# ~Manuale per il Maneggio di Materiali Pericolosi~

jp: \t\t過去の生物の遺骸が堆積岩に封じ込められたもの。体組織は古い地層では鉱物に置換されているが、比較的新しい地層だと残っていたりする。生化学文明紀には、化石から元の生物を復元する技術も確立されていたという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t過去の生物の遺骸が堆積岩に封じ込められたもの。体組織は古い地層では鉱物に置換されているが、比較的新しい地層だと残っていたりする。生化学文明紀には、化石から元の生物を復元する技術も確立されていたという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Remains of past organisms encapsulated in sedimentary rocks. Body tissues have been replaced by minerals in older strata, but may remain in relatively newer strata. During the Biogeocenozoic period, the technology to reconstruct original organisms from fossils was established. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Remains of past organisms encapsulated in sedimentary rocks. Body tissues have been replaced by minerals in older strata, but may remain in relatively newer strata. During the Biogeocenozoic period, the technology to reconstruct original organisms from fossils was established. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: I resti di esseri vissuti un tempo, chiusi dentro una roccia sedimentaria. Nei terreni antichi i tessuti sono stati sostituiti da minerali, ma in quelli più recenti a volte restano. Nell'era della civiltà biochimica, dicono, si era arrivati anche alla tecnica per ricostruire dal fossile l'essere di partenza. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t非常に細かい粒子でできた土。手でこねて細工できるが、熱すると固くなる。その性質を利用して陶器などが作られる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t非常に細かい粒子でできた土。手でこねて細工できるが、熱すると固くなる。その性質を利用して陶器などが作られる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: Soil consisting of very fine particles. It can be kneaded by hand and becomes hard when heated. This property is used to make ceramics. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "Soil consisting of very fine particles. It can be kneaded by hand and becomes hard when heated. This property is used to make ceramics. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Terra fatta di grani molto fini. La si lavora impastandola a mano, e scaldandola diventa dura. È per questa sua qualità che ci si fanno le ceramiche. \n#~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t燃える石の異名を持つ鉱物。かつての文明では様々な分野で原料とされていたらしいが、現代イルヴァではあまり需要がない。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t燃える石の異名を持つ鉱物。かつての文明では様々な分野で原料とされていたらしいが、現代イルヴァではあまり需要がない。\n#～ヴェルニース鉱物図鑑～\n"
en: A mineral with the nickname 'burning stone'. It is said to have been used as a raw material in various fields in former civilizations, but there is not much demand for it in modern Irva. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A mineral with the nickname 'burning stone'. It is said to have been used as a raw material in various fields in former civilizations, but there is not much demand for it in modern Irva. \n#~Vernis Ore Catalogue~"
it: Un minerale che ha per soprannome pietra che brucia. Nelle civiltà passate, pare, era materia prima in molti campi, ma nell'Irva di oggi non se ne cerca granché. \n#~Atlante dei Minerali di Vernis~

jp: \t\t生化学文明で用いられていたサバイバル器具。外付けの脂肪のようなもの。余剰な質量をエネルギー源に変換して長期的に蓄え、必要に応じて元に戻す機能がある。当時の人間の体質に合わせて開発されたため、現代生物には身長体重維持くらいの効果しか出ない。餓死は防止できないのでちゃんとご飯は食べよう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n

en: Survival equipment used in biochemical civilization. It is like an external fat. It has the function of converting excess mass into an energy source, storing it for a long period of time, and then restoring it as needed. Because it was developed for the human physique of the time, it is only as effective as maintaining height and weight for modern organisms. It cannot prevent starvation, so make sure you eat your food. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~

It has the function of converting excess mass into an energy source, storing it for a long period of time, and then restoring it as needed. Because it was developed for the human physique of the time, it is only as effective as maintaining height and weight for modern organisms. It cannot prevent starvation, so make sure you eat your food. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Un arnese da sopravvivenza che si usava nella civiltà biochimica. È come del grasso attaccato fuori. Sa cambiare la massa in più in una riserva di energia, tenerla a lungo e restituirla quando serve. Siccome l'hanno fatto sulla costituzione degli uomini di allora, sui viventi di oggi l'effetto arriva sì e no a mantenere altezza e peso. jp: \t\t切り花を一つにまとめて装飾を施した贈り物。しかし、本気が伝わりすぎてむしろ重い。あまり仲のよくない相手に贈るとドン引きされるので、渡す相手はよく考えよう。\n#～選ぼう、大切な人への贈り物～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t切り花を一つにまとめて装飾を施した贈り物。しかし、本気が伝わりすぎてむしろ重い。あまり仲のよくない相手に贈るとドン引きされるので、渡す相手はよく考えよう。\n#～選ぼう、大切な人への贈り物～\n"
en: A gift of trimmed flowers, all in one decorative package. However, it conveys too much seriousness and is rather heavy. If you give it to someone you don't get along with very well, they will be turned off, so think carefully about who you give it to. \n#~Gift for your loved ones~
en_grezzo: "A gift of trimmed flowers, all in one decorative package. However, it conveys too much seriousness and is rather heavy. If you give it to someone you don't get along with very well, they will be turned off, so think carefully about who you give it to. \n#~Gift for your loved ones~"
it: Un dono di fiori recisi messi insieme e decorati. Solo che dice fin troppo bene quanto uno ci tenga, e finisce per pesare. A regalarlo a qualcuno con cui non si va molto d'accordo lo si mette a disagio: pensa bene a chi lo dai. \n#~Scegliamo un Dono per Chi ci sta a Cuore~

jp: \t\t一見すると模様が描かれただけの紙だが、魔力が込められている。投げると空気抵抗をものともせず軽やかに飛んでいき、触れた相手に魔法ダメージを与え祝福効果も消す。威力は使用者の魔道具と投擲の技術にもよる。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一見すると模様が描かれただけの紙だが、魔力が込められている。投げると空気抵抗をものともせず軽やかに飛んでいき、触れた相手に魔法ダメージを与え祝福効果も消す。威力は使用者の魔道具と投擲の技術にもよる。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: At first glance, it appears to be just a piece of paper with a pattern drawn on it, but it is imbued with magical power. When thrown, it flies lightly through the air, dealing magical damage to anyone it touches and removing blessing effects. Its power depends on the user's magical equipment and throwing technique. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~

it: A prima vista è solo un foglio con sopra un disegno, ma dentro ci hanno messo forza magica. Lanciandolo vola leggero senza curarsi dell'aria, fa danno magico a chi tocca e cancella anche l'effetto della benedizione. La potenza dipende anche da Dispositivi magici e da Lancio di chi lo usa. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t特定の時期に目を覚ますと、置いた覚えもないのにいつの間にか傍らに置かれている不思議な箱。他人に贈りつけると、敵対する者には痛みを、友好的な者には癒しを与えるという謎の物体。どうしても包装を剥がすことができないので中身の確認ができないが、一説によると災厄と希望が込められているという。\n#～魔具全典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t特定の時期に目を覚ますと、置いた覚えもないのにいつの間にか傍らに置かれている不思議な箱。他人に贈りつけると、敵対する者には痛みを、友好的な者には癒しを与えるという謎の物体。どうしても包装を剥がすことができないので中身の確認ができないが、一説によると災厄と希望が込められているという。\n#～魔具全典～\n"
en: When you wake up at certain times of the year, this mysterious box is placed beside you before you know it. When presented to others, this mysterious object is said to bring pain to those who are hostile to it and healing to those who are friendly to it. Since the wrapping cannot be removed by any means, the contents cannot be confirmed, but according to one theory, it is said to contain both disaster and hope. \n# ~Arcane Almanac~

it: Una scatola misteriosa che, in certi periodi, al risveglio ti ritrovi accanto senza ricordarti di averla messa lì. Regalandola, dicono, dà dolore a chi ti è nemico e sollievo a chi ti è amico: un oggetto che nessuno capisce. L'involucro non si stacca in nessun modo, così che il contenuto non si può vedere; ma secondo una voce ci sono dentro la sciagura e la speranza. \n# ~Compendio Completo degli Oggetti Magici~

jp: \t\t短くなって捨てられた紙巻タバコの残骸。この状態でも発火することがあるので注意。発生する火は弱いが、間違ってもそこら辺に投げ捨てたりしてはいけない。\n#～道端の危険物～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t短くなって捨てられた紙巻タバコの残骸。この状態でも発火することがあるので注意。発生する火は弱いが、間違ってもそこら辺に投げ捨てたりしてはいけない。\n#～道端の危険物～\n"
en: Remnants of shortened and discarded cigarettes. Note that even in this state, it might still ignite. Although the fire is weak, do not throw it on the ground by mistake. \n#~Dangers on the Road~
en_grezzo: "Remnants of shortened and discarded cigarettes. Note that even in this state, it might still ignite. Although the fire is weak, do not throw it on the ground by mistake. \n#~Dangers on the Road~"
it: Quel che resta di una sigaretta fumata e buttata via. Attenzione: anche così può prendere fuoco. La fiamma che fa è debole, ma non ti venga in mente di gettarlo in giro. \n#~I Pericoli sul Ciglio della Strada~

jp: \t\tナスの親戚の植物。様々な形に加工され、喫煙に用いられる。古代では体に有害なものだったが、生化学文明期に品種改良された。現行種は毒性を持たず、逆に多量の薬効成分が含まれているので安心…と思いきや、依存性はあるので注意。そのまま葉を噛んでも風味を楽しめ、ニコチンを補給することができる。質の良いものなら禁煙の助けにもなるだろう。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n

en: A relative of the eggplant. It is processed into various forms and used for smoking. In ancient times it was toxic to the body, but was bred during biochemical civilization. The current species is not toxic, on the contrary, it contains a large amount of medicinal properties, so it is safe...but be careful, it is addictive. You can chew the leaves as they are to enjoy the flavor and provide nicotine. If they are of good quality, they can help you quit smoking. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~

it: Una pianta parente della melanzana. La lavorano in tanti modi e serve per fumare. Nell'antichità faceva male, ma nell'era della civiltà biochimica l'hanno migliorata. La specie di oggi non è velenosa, anzi ha dentro molte sostanze che curano, quindi si sta tranquilli... o quasi: dà dipendenza, e va tenuto a mente. Anche masticando la foglia così com'è si sente il sapore e si prende la nicotina. Se è di buona qualità può perfino aiutare a smettere. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\t純粋な銅ではなく青銅でできているのでカッパーコインではない。感謝を示したいがプラチナ硬貨を出すほどではない…という時用に作られた。近年流通し始めたものであり、プラチナ硬貨と比べるとまだ馴染みが薄い。\n#～世界のコイン・ティリス編～\n

Ha cominciato a girare da poco, e rispetto alla moneta di platino è ancora poco familiare. \n# ~Le Monete del Mondo: Tyris~
